_crawl.linkedin_about: ASUS is a global technology leader delivering incredible experiences that enhance the lives of people everywhere. World renowned for continuously reimagining today’s technologies for tomorrow, ASUS puts users first In Search of Incredible to provide the world’s most innovative and intuitive devices, components, and solutions. Today’s ASUS is more ambitious than ever, unleashing remarkable gaming, content-creation, AIoT, and cloud solutions that solve user needs and infuse delight. ASUS is home to industry-leading experts who are encouraged to pursue their passion for innovation and entrepreneurial spirit to deliver the future of technology to the world. With a team of 5,000 in-house R&D colleagues, ASUS received more than 11 awards every day in 2020 and is ranked as one of Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies. Working together as One Team, ASUS team members strive to transform and evolve, trust in radical truth and transparency, and embrace idea meritocracy and foster collective wisdom in the limitless pursuit of the incredible. And because tomorrow's experiences start with today’s actions, the people of ASUS are setting new industry standards and delivering on a strong commitment to environmental and community stewardship every day. At ASUS, every individual can find the opportunity to push the limits of what is yet to be imagined, and to make it real. To learn more about our aspirations and what we offer, visit asus.com/about-asus/

The Signatur Collection

Characterized by clean lines, uncluttered dials, and artful use of negative space, this bestselling
platform encapsulates modern style and Scandinavian minimalism by elevating detailing in its
simplest form.

[Shop Mellem][139]

The Mellem Collection

The Mellem embodies minimalist design by striking a perfect balance between geometric forms. Its
sculptural case seamlessly blends a circle with a square, inspired by Scandinavian artists and
architects who harmoniously merge nature's curves with tactile geometry.

[Shop His][140] [Shop Hers][141]
[feature of pearls jewelry]
[Shop Jewelry][142]

Jewelry

Our jewelry pieces are effortlessly modern and uniquely refined, bringing a fresh approach to
everyday basics. Designed with organic shapes and minimalist details, they offer versatility and
comfort, perfect for layering and creating a sleek, polished statement.

[Shop His][143] [Shop Hers][144]

Skagen celebrates the Danish way of life: free, spontaneous, and in the moment. Our watches and
jewelry are fueled by a love of modern design––playing with color and current fashion influences.

We’re energized by the Copenhagen fashion scene and emerging Danish designers who mix and match bold
colors and patterns.

We’re finding refreshed inspiration in Denmark’s landscape—iridescent seas, vibrant skies, rocky
shorelines. Our modern designs draw from these natural influences.

We're dialed-in to purposeful design that speaks to the now—modern, functional, simple pieces with
enduring characteristics.

## Galax FAQ

**Are you a smartwatch manufacturer?**

Yes. Galax is a [professional smartwatch manufacturer][19] in Shenzhen, focusing on 4G GPS, SOS, and

**Do you offer [OEM and ODM customization][20]?**

Yes. We support full OEM/ODM services, including logo, packaging, UI, firmware, and private-model

**Which smartwatch models are designed for elderly monitoring?**

Our [elderly-care series includes][21] S3, F21 Pro, F800, featuring 4G LTE, GPS tracking, SOS
button, and fall detection.

**Do your smartwatches support 4G LTE and real-time GPS?**

Yes. Many models support [4G LTE, with GPS][22] + LBS + WiFi positioning for high-accuracy outdoor
and indoor tracking.

Yes. We customize LTE bands for Asia, Europe, Africa, North & South America.

Yes. Our 4G GPS watches include a physical SOS button that sends instant alerts with real-time
location.

Features include [heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2][23], sleep tracking, and optional fall
detection.

Yes. Selected models are [IP67 or IP68 waterproof][24], suitable for daily use and showering.

### [Health Surveillance][11]

Real-time monitoring of changes in health conditions within the state, county, or zip code

## Why We Stand Out

Health Monitoring provides software services that collect and analyze healthcare data to illuminate
complex, large-scale health issues. The growing cost and complexity of healthcare demands greater
insight into regional and national health issues.

### Software as a Service

Delivering our software as a service means ongoing improvements and fast implementation. And every
updated version features our combination of healthcare knowledge, statistical precision, and
state-of-the-art technology.  

### Healthcare Facility Network

We have one of the largest healthcare data networks in the U.S. That matters because collecting data
from so many sources makes it faster and cheaper for you to analyze, investigate, and take action.

### Big Data

In operation since 2008, the EpiCenter system now collects and processes more than 2 GB of data each
day. What this means for you: Health Monitoring has the experience and expertise to help you do big
things with your big data.

Take a look at

## EpiCenter’s Capabilities

EpiCenter helps state and local health officials stay up to date on the well-being of their
communities. It collects and analyzes intake data from healthcare facilities in real time, providing
**information-rich, in-depth coverage** of entire states and counties.

Thanks to EpiCenter’s **geographic reach and statistical sophistication**, public health can easily
monitor and identify possible threats as they emerge — whether those are outbreaks of seasonal
diseases such as influenza, or chronic community health issues such as opioid abuse.

### About Health Monitoring

**Our mission:** Provide services that focus healthcare resources on existing and emergent threats
to community health.

**Our customers:** State and local public health departments and health systems. We currently serve
Connecticut, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Wyoming, and several counties in California, covering a
total of more than 40 million people.

**What we do:** Monitor real-time health-related data for community health indicators. We collect
data from nearly 600 hospitals and 3,600 ambulatory systems.

The Signatur Collection

Characterized by clean lines, uncluttered dials, and artful use of negative space, this bestselling
platform encapsulates modern style and Scandinavian minimalism by elevating detailing in its
simplest form.

[Shop His][137] [Shop Hers][138]
[feature of gun mellem]
[Shop Mellem][139]

The Mellem Collection

The Mellem embodies minimalist design by striking a perfect balance between geometric forms. Its
sculptural case seamlessly blends a circle with a square, inspired by Scandinavian artists and
architects who harmoniously merge nature's curves with tactile geometry.

[Shop His][140] [Shop Hers][141]
[feature of pearls jewelry]
[Shop Jewelry][142]

Jewelry

Our jewelry pieces are effortlessly modern and uniquely refined, bringing a fresh approach to
everyday basics. Designed with organic shapes and minimalist details, they offer versatility and
comfort, perfect for layering and creating a sleek, polished statement.

[Shop His][143] [Shop Hers][144]

Skagen celebrates the Danish way of life: free, spontaneous, and in the moment. Our watches and
jewelry are fueled by a love of modern design––playing with color and current fashion influences.

We’re energized by the Copenhagen fashion scene and emerging Danish designers who mix and match bold
colors and patterns.

We’re finding refreshed inspiration in Denmark’s landscape—iridescent seas, vibrant skies, rocky
shorelines. Our modern designs draw from these natural influences.

We're dialed-in to purposeful design that speaks to the now—modern, functional, simple pieces with
enduring characteristics.

# My Aadhaar UIDAI Login – Easy Download & Check Status 2026

The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) oversees the Aadhaar project, which provides a
12-digit unique identity number to Indian residents. Established by the Government of India in 2009,
UIDAI manages key Aadhaar services through the My Aadhaar portal, offering a streamlined approach
for citizens to download e-Aadhaar, update personal details, and track their status. The platform
also supports features like generating a Virtual ID (VID), ordering PVC Aadhaar cards, and checking
Aadhaar status—all designed to simplify processes for users.

**[Aadhaar UIDAI][19]** services help users easily access essential Aadhaar-related information and
guidance online. As one of the world’s largest biometric identity systems, Aadhaar connects
residents to various government services, banking, and mobile communications, ensuring nationwide
accessibility. Through its continuous updates and mobile-friendly services, UIDAI ensures a secure
and accessible experience for all users, reinforcing India’s push towards digital governance. With
key features like biometric authentication and digital verification, the platform enhances
transparency and safeguards against identity fraud, making it an integral part of daily life for
millions of Indians.

**Aether** — in ancient Greek philosophy, aether was the pure, luminous essence that filled the
heavens and gave life to the stars: the fifth element, beyond earth, water, air, and fire.

We chose this name because it captures exactly what we set out to create **technology that feels
effortless, refined, and a step above the ordinary**.

That’s why we’re proud to offer a wide selection of smartwatches, each equipped with advanced
features designed to meet your everyday needs.

Whether it’s heart rate tracking (via a precision heart rate sensor), counting your daily steps with
the built-in pedometer, blood oxygen levels, sleep quality, or intense physical activity, our
connected devices are thoughtfully engineered to meet every kind of need.Every smartwatch we offer
is carefully selected for its durability, performance, and intuitive touchscreen display.

**Welcome to Avelr Smartwatches!**

At Avelr, we take pride in offering innovative and high-quality smartwatches for children and
adults. Whether you’re looking for advanced GPS tracking, fitness monitoring, or customizable
features, we are here to cater to your needs.

If you have any questions or specific requirements, don’t hesitate to reach out to us. Our team is
ready to assist you. Send us an email at **[[email protected]][26]**, and we’ll provide you with
detailed assistance promptly!

### **Discover Avelr's Featured Smartwatches for Kids and Adults**

**
**Explore our curated selection of Avelr smartwatches, with a focus on models designed specifically
for kids. Our children’s smartwatches offer essential features like GPS tracking, health monitoring,
and Bluetooth calling, providing both safety and connectivity for young users. Additionally, browse
select models tailored for adults, ideal for fitness tracking, wellness, and outdoor adventures. For
our full range of smartwatches, visit our complete catalog.

### **New & Improved - Explore Avelr's Latest Featured Smartwatches**

**
**Discover the innovative and stylish smartwatches in our featured collection. From kid-friendly GPS
tracking and Bluetooth calling watches to advanced health and fitness trackers for adults, Avelr’s
latest models combine technology and style. Perfect for parents looking for safety features or
fitness enthusiasts aiming to reach their health goals. Dive into our selection and find the
smartwatch that fits your lifestyle.

anyone to measure a wide range of health and wellness indicators using a smartphone or tablet
camera.

comprehensive overview of a person’s health and wellness, from vital signs and chronic disease risks
to stress levels, bloodless blood tests, and more.

and manufacturing of smart wearable products.

release only the most premium finished products on the market. We hope to use our more than ten
years of industry-leading experience to help you succeed in the smart wearable market.

## What is Da Fit?

Da Fit is a smartwatch brand and connected app experience from Moyoung Technology. dafit.life is the
official Da Fit website for app downloads, product information, setup help, and support. The Da Fit
app helps users set up compatible watches, sync daily wellness data, customize watch faces, manage
notifications, and use Da Fit branded smartwatches such as P125M.

Official links

## Download the Da Fit app

Use the official App Store or Google Play links on this site to install the Da Fit app. If you are
buying a Da Fit branded smartwatch, review the product page first, then use the app to pair, sync,
and manage the watch.

My watch will not connect

Restart Bluetooth, keep the watch near the phone, remove stale pairings, then pair from inside Da
Fit. If your phone closes Da Fit in the background, follow the phone-system guide.

Notifications are not showing

Check notification permission, app-specific alert toggles, Do Not Disturb mode, and background
activity settings.

Sleep data is missing

Wear the device snugly while sleeping, sync data in time, and note that sleep is usually recorded
when sleep starts between 8 PM and 10 AM.

Weather is not displaying

Confirm the watch is connected, weather is enabled in Da Fit, location permission is allowed, and
weather data has synced from the phone.

# Smarter health worldwide.

The Global Digital Health Monitor is an interactive digital resource that tracks, monitors, and
evaluates the use of digital technology for health across countries.

[ Visit the MONITOR → ][18]
 
 
[
][19]


## About the Global Digital Health Monitor

The Global Digital Health Monitor (GDHM) is an interactive digital resource that helps countries to
prioritize and monitor their digital health interventions and enablers that uses the WHO/ITU eHealth
Strategy Toolkit as the underlying foundational framework. The tool consists of 23 indicators in the
areas of leadership & governance; strategy & investment; legislation, policy & compliance;
workforce; standards & interoperability; infrastructure; services & applications; and cross-cutting
issues like emerging technology and equity.

[evaluate.png]

**The aim of the global digital health monitor is to:**
* Monitor and improve quality of digital health at the country level
* Track progress towards comprehensive and integrated digital health systems 
* Identify areas of funding and technical assistance needs within and across countries  
* Encourage better alignment among policy makers, donors, and implementers in the digital health
  field in alignment with the Principles for Digital Development and Donor Alignment for Digital
  Health
* Highlight potential areas of risk for investment at the country level

In early 2016,[**health.enabled**][20] and the[ **Global Development Incubator (GDI)**][21]
partnered with[ **Dalberg’s Design Impact Group (DIG)**][22],[ **ThoughtWorks**][23], and
representatives from 20+ countries and 50+ international agencies and organizations to design the
**Global Digital Health Index (GDHI)**.

In 2022, the GDHI underwent a year-long review and redesign process to align the indicators with the
World Health Organization (WHO) Global Digital Health Strategy as a complement to the WHO Digital
Health Atlas and include a greater focus on AI, equity, gender, and Universal Health Coverage.

In 2023, the name was changed to the **Global Digital Health Monitor (GDHM)** to articulate the
platform’s value in monitoring digital health progress at the country, regional, and global levels.
The updated GDHM includes year on year performance monitoring country visualizations, regional
visualizations, and country to country comparisons.

The GDHM is now officially recognized as the monitoring platform for digital health ecosystems in
WHO Member States, serving as a critical tool for standardizing, tracking, and advancing digital
health progress globally.

**Learn more **[**here**][24]** (**[**French version**][25]**).**


## Team

The GDHM is co-facilitated by [**health.enabled**][26], a digital health nonprofit, and the
[**Global Development Incubator (GDI)**][27]**,** an organization that builds social impact startups
and partnerships. [**ThoughtWorks**][28] is the technology partner and [**Dalberg Design**][29] is
the design partner.

[
][30]
 
 


## Technical Committee

The GDHM Technical Committee includes a broad range of government, private sector, academic, NGO,
and other top institutions and individuals in digital health:
* Sean Blaschke, **UNICEF**
* Joseline Carias, **RECAINSA **
* Emanuele Capobianco, **WHO Foundation**
* Gabriel Catan, **World Bank**
* Rebecca Distler, **McGovern Foundation**
* Vajira Dissanayake, **Commonwealth Medical Association **
* Carine Gachen, **Gavi **
* Jai Ganesh Udayasankaran, **AeHIN**
* Skye Gilbert, **PATH**
* Rajendra Gupta, **Ministry of Health India**
* Boonchai Kijsanayotin, **Ministry of Public Health, Thailand/Asia e-Health Network **
* Mark Landry, **Global Fund**
* Ousmane Ly, **Digital Health Consultant**
* Jeroen Maas, **Philips**
* Alvin Marcelo, **University of the Philippines Manila **
* Dykki Settle, **PATH **
* Lucy Setian, **Novartis **
* Professor Teng Liaw Siaw, **WHO Collaborating Centre for eHealth based at UNSW, Sydney **
* Chaitali Sinha, **IDRC **
* Frank Smith, **Transform Health **
* Steve Wanyee, **Intellisoft Kenya**
* Adele Waugaman, **USAID**
* Tim Wood, **Gates Foundation**


## Partners

In addition to our team and funders, GDHM is pleased to count several global organizations as
partners, including the [Asian Development Bank][31], [Asia eHealth Information Network][32],
[Commonwealth Medical Organization][33], [EMPHNET][34], [International Development Research
Centre][35], [International Society for Telemedicine and eHealth][36], [International

**Learn more **[**here**][24]** (**[**French version**][25]**).**


## Team

The GDHM is co-facilitated by [**health.enabled**][26], a digital health nonprofit, and the
[**Global Development Incubator (GDI)**][27]**,** an organization that builds social impact startups
and partnerships. [**ThoughtWorks**][28] is the technology partner and [**Dalberg Design**][29] is
the design partner.

[
][30]
 
 


## Technical Committee

The GDHM Technical Committee includes a broad range of government, private sector, academic, NGO,
and other top institutions and individuals in digital health:
* Sean Blaschke, **UNICEF**
* Joseline Carias, **RECAINSA **
* Emanuele Capobianco, **WHO Foundation**
* Gabriel Catan, **World Bank**
* Rebecca Distler, **McGovern Foundation**

* Carine Gachen, **Gavi **

* Skye Gilbert, **PATH**
* Rajendra Gupta, **Ministry of Health India**
* Boonchai Kijsanayotin, **Ministry of Public Health, Thailand/Asia e-Health Network **
* Mark Landry, **Global Fund**
* Ousmane Ly, **Digital Health Consultant**
* Jeroen Maas, **Philips**
* Alvin Marcelo, **University of the Philippines Manila **
* Dykki Settle, **PATH **
* Lucy Setian, **Novartis **
* Professor Teng Liaw Siaw, **WHO Collaborating Centre for eHealth based at UNSW, Sydney **
* Chaitali Sinha, **IDRC **
* Frank Smith, **Transform Health **
* Steve Wanyee, **Intellisoft Kenya**
* Adele Waugaman, **USAID**
* Tim Wood, **Gates Foundation**


## Partners

In addition to our team and funders, GDHM is pleased to count several global organizations as
partners, including the [Asian Development Bank][31], [Asia eHealth Information Network][32],
[Commonwealth Medical Organization][33], [EMPHNET][34], [International Development Research
Centre][35], [International Society for Telemedicine and eHealth][36], [International
Telecommunications Union][37], [The Global Fund][38],[ Gavi][39],[ The Vaccine Alliance][40], [The
Patrick J. McGovern Foundation][41], [Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health][42],
[PATH][43], [RECAINSA][44], [USAID][45], [UNICEF][46], and the [World Health Organization][47].

Fitness has become easier
Our app supports smartwatch operation to make your workouts even more effective.
Now you can monitor your progress at any time.
Access to ready-made training plans
If you don't want to waste time developing your programs, choose from a variety of ready-made
training plans created by professional trainers.
Individual approach to training
Change your training plans at any time. Your goals, schedule, and training level may change, and our
service allows you to adjust your program without unnecessary difficulties.
Your workouts — your way
Build your own programs or choose from ready-made plans.
Ai nutritionist
- Personal recommendations: Takes into account goals, preferences and allergies.
- Diet Tracking: Daily nutrition correction tips.
Ai coach
- Personalized plans: Takes into account the level, goals and preferences.
- Progress analysis: Tracking and recommendations for improvement.
Ai doctor
- Analysis and recommendations: Improves well-being in real time.
- Prevention and diagnosis: Indicates risks and suggests measures in advance.
Ai assistant
- Organization of the day:
Helps you plan your workouts, work, and vacations effectively.
- Reminders:
Notifies you about workouts, meals, and medical checkups.
Your coach, always with you
Get smart guidance and personalised plans from your AI coach.
Increased power and speed
Alternating between exercise and rest contributes to the development of strength and speed.
Improvement of the cardiovascular system
Interval training stimulates the heart and increases lung capacity.
Increased metabolism
An increased metabolic rate after exercise helps burn calories even at rest.
Effective calorie burning
Intense exercise allows you to achieve a calorie deficit faster, contributing to weight loss.
Boost your endurance
Interval training designed for maximum effectiveness.
Increasing the effectiveness of training
The analysis of daily results allows you to optimize workouts and increase their effect.
Visualizing progress
Graphs and infographics make it easy to assess changes in results and achievements.
More precise planning
Users can adjust their fitness goals and plans based on detailed data from previous sessions.
Motivation
Visual representation of data serves as a motivator and allows users to see real improvements.
Track your progress day by day
Detailed daily reports help you see your growth, step by step.
This is a section with frequently asked questions and answers. Popular user questions are collected
here so that you can easily understand all the nuances of usage.
FAQ
What workouts are available in the app?
The app offers workouts for various fitness levels: cardio, strength training, yoga, stretching, and
much more.
Is it necessary to purchase a paid subscription?
Basic features are free. A subscription is required for access to advanced workouts and personalized
programs.
Can I track my results?
Yes, the app automatically tracks your progress, the number of workouts completed, calories burned,
and achievements.
Does the app support creating a personalized plan?
Yes, the app creates a personalized workout plan based on your goals and parameters.
What devices are supported?
The app is available for iOS and Android smartphones. Some features can connect to fitness bands and
smartwatches.
Can workouts be done offline without internet access?
Yes, many workouts and plans can be downloaded in advance and used without an internet connection.
Your progress will sync when the internet is available again.

## Why We Stand Out

Health Monitoring provides software services that collect and analyze healthcare data to illuminate
complex, large-scale health issues. The growing cost and complexity of healthcare demands greater
insight into regional and national health issues.

### Software as a Service

Delivering our software as a service means ongoing improvements and fast implementation. And every
updated version features our combination of healthcare knowledge, statistical precision, and
state-of-the-art technology.  

### Healthcare Facility Network

We have one of the largest healthcare data networks in the U.S. That matters because collecting data
from so many sources makes it faster and cheaper for you to analyze, investigate, and take action.

### Big Data

In operation since 2008, the EpiCenter system now collects and processes more than 2 GB of data each
day. What this means for you: Health Monitoring has the experience and expertise to help you do big
things with your big data.

Take a look at

## EpiCenter’s Capabilities

EpiCenter helps state and local health officials stay up to date on the well-being of their
communities. It collects and analyzes intake data from healthcare facilities in real time, providing
**information-rich, in-depth coverage** of entire states and counties.

Thanks to EpiCenter’s **geographic reach and statistical sophistication**, public health can easily
monitor and identify possible threats as they emerge — whether those are outbreaks of seasonal
diseases such as influenza, or chronic community health issues such as opioid abuse.

### About Health Monitoring

**Our mission:** Provide services that focus healthcare resources on existing and emergent threats
to community health.

**Our customers:** State and local public health departments and health systems. We currently serve
Connecticut, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Wyoming, and several counties in California, covering a
total of more than 40 million people.

**What we do:** Monitor real-time health-related data for community health indicators. We collect
data from nearly 600 hospitals and 3,600 ambulatory systems.

## into one place

### Unlock adaptive, proactive coaching with Google Health Premium

Meet your Google Health Coach, built with Gemini¹

[ See how it works ][14]

## Have a question about your health and wellness?

Users can ask Google Health Coach anything, at any time, and get relevant answers and tailored
insights based on your data.

[ Try it now ][15]
[Image of Google Health app conversation with the Health Coach about how caffeine is affecting the
user's sleep.]
[Image of sleep results in the Google Health app.]

## Designed for where you are today and where you're heading next.

[Image of man going for a run wearing Google Fitbit Air.]

## Plans that fit your goals – and your life

Google Health Coach builds personalised and adaptable workout plans that put your fitness goals in
the context of your whole life. You set the priorities and aspirations, and your coach follows your
lead with guidance that continuously adapts to you.¹

[Image of a woman going for a run wearing Google Fitbit Air.]
[Image of woman doing yoga outside wearing Google Fitbit Air.]

## Take the guesswork out of rest and recovery

Rest is key to progress. Google Health Coach goes beyond tracking your sleep to help you understand
your sleep patterns. Your coach connects the dots in your data and offers relevant, actionable
guidance, helping you wake up ready for what's ahead.^{1, 2}

[Image of a woman sleeping wearing Google Fitbit Air.]
[Image of woman sitting on sofa, drinking coffee and reviewing her stats in the Google Health app. ]

## See a holistic view of your whole health and wellness

Your coach provides personalised guidance across fitness, sleep and wellness, helping you see
connections in your data and understand patterns. Spot trends, make informed choices and work
towards your goals with support that adapts to your journey.¹

[Image of man recovering after a workout wearing Google Fitbit Air.]
[Image of a woman dancing wearing Google Fitbit Air.]

## Stay in tune with your cycle

Your menstrual cycle affects more than you think. Google Health Coach helps you understand how it
shapes your sleep, fitness and daily routines, revealing insights in your data and answering your
cycle health questions at any time.^{1,3}

[Image of a woman wearing Google Fitbit Air.]

## In partnership with a pro

As a world-class athlete, Stephen Curry knows a thing or three about performance. Now, he's bringing
his experience and expertise to Google Health, so that everyone can perform their best.
[ Meet our experts ][16]

## Personal, proactive, secure and in your control [Google Shield]

Control your data with easy-to-find and easy-to-use privacy settings for your most sensitive data
types, and turn optional features on or off at any time.
* Google committed to not use Fitbit users’ health and wellness data for Google Ads
* Transmissions are always encrypted
* You control who accesses your health information
[ Learn how we protect your data ][17]

  through wearables like Fitbit, Pixel Watch and other devices. It includes a digital health coach

## FAQ
* What is Google Health and how does it work?
  Google Health is a health and wellness service that tracks your fitness, sleep and health data
  through wearables like Fitbit, Pixel Watch and other devices. It includes a digital health coach
  built with Gemini that works as your AI coach, using your metrics to adapt workout plans, optimise
  your sleep schedule and answer health and wellness questions specific to you. Developed with
  health experts, your coach gets smarter as it learns your patterns, helping you make progress that
  actually sticks.^{1, 2}
* What can you do with Google Health?
  The Google Health app brings together your fitness, sleep, and health data from wearables and apps
  to give you a holistic view of your health and wellness in one place. With a Premium membership,
  you get an AI coach built with Gemini that gives you workout plans that adjust based on how
  recovered you are, helps you find out how much sleep your body needs, and answers questions about
  nutrition or what your metrics mean.^{1, 2}
* Is Google Health free of charge?
  Yes, Google Health can be downloaded and used free of charge. You can track your metrics at no
  cost. There's also a Premium membership available that unlocks proactive coaching and
  personalisation across fitness, sleep and health.¹
* Can Google Health connect with other health apps and devices?
  Yes. Google Health connects with a wide range of wearables, apps and devices for activity and
  wellness tracking. It works with Fitbit, Pixel Watch and other compatible trackers, syncing data
  from fitness apps, smart scales, glucose monitors and more.
* Can Google Health help track your period?
  Yes. Google Health tracks your menstrual cycle, including predicted periods, fertile windows and
  symptoms like mood, flow and energy. Your data builds over time, giving you a clearer picture of
  your cycle and how it connects to your sleep, fitness and daily routines. You can also ask Google
  Health Coach questions about your cycle health at any time and get answers based on your personal
  data.^{1,3}

## Are Intex products available on eCommerce platforms?

Yes. Intex products are also available on leading eCommerce platforms including Amazon, Flipkart,
and Zepto.

## Is Intex an Indian electronics brand?

Yes. Intex is a leading Indian consumer electronics brand, operating since 1996.

# What’s There In The Solution

## Connected Devices
* Access to bluetooth connected Glucometer, Blood pressure monitor, Weighing scale, Fetal heart
  monitor & Hemoglobinometer.
* Track real time vitals, watch trends and download reports.

## Support at your finger tips
* One-on-one expert support through our partner care providers (Doctors, Nurses and Health Coaches).
* Timely technical support for devices and emergencies.

## Nudges and Alerts
* Evidence based nudges to help patients stay on track.
* Personalized engagement programs for improving patient compliance.

# How remote monitoring works*

## Care provider recommends
* Doctors prescribe the package and enroll the patient.

## Registration
* Patients enter their details and register themselves on the platform. After which the care
  management team designs a plan personalized for them.

## Patient Onboarding
* The care management team will send a device kit to the patient and onboard the patient on our
  platform.

## Journey Begins
* The patient downloads the app and starts monitoring to begin their journey towards a healthier
  life!

*For our one-to-many model please check the [population health][27] page

data by our expert. Manage your time efficiently with a hassle-free solution including customer and
technical support, zero-charge hardware configuration, and maintenance.

requirements. Get the full benefits of remote monitoring for your hospital or organization.

## AI Based Predictive Maintenance

Nanoprecise’s AI Based Predictive Maintenance solutions drive mechanical and operational
efficiencies that increase production and safety while reducing carbon footprints.

[Learn More][44]

### Prescriptive Maintenance

Empowering your maintenance team with actionable insights on where and how to spend their time.

[LEARN MORE][45]
[Digitize without noise]

### **Digitize Without Confusion**

We help teams digitize intelligently, filtering noise while delivering visibility without overload,
so you can focus on what matters.

[LEARN MORE][46]

### The MachineDoctor Sensor

The 6-in-1 machine health sensor monitoring the most available data possible on the health of your
equipment.

[LEARN MORE][47]

## WHY NANOPRECISE?
* [Unmatched Cybersecurity][48]
* [Energy Conscious][49]
* [Scalable Connectivity][50]
* [Ease of Deployment][51]

### Unmatched Cybersecurity

We respect the privacy and security of your data and have custom-built our solutions with it in
mind. From collection to transmission to storage, our SOC 2 Type 2 compliant layered approach
ensures true peace of mind.  

### Energy Conscious

We are proud to be moving beyond Predictive Maintenance and making a shift to caring for the
environment and your organizations role in protecting it. Our Energy-Centric [Predictive Maintenance
solutions][52] drive productivity, efficiencies and profits.

### Scalable Connectivity

One of the most important parts of IoT monitoring is ensuring repeatable, secure connectivity. We’ve
designed our sensors for scalable, cellular or WiFi connectivity, delivering ease of deployment and
consistent transmission.

### Ease of Deployment

The design of our sensors and their scalable connectivity ensures they can be easily deployed within
a multitude of environments directly onto equipment.

## Let us show you how!

Explore the transformative potential of [predictive maintenance][53]. At Nanoprecise, we specialize
in tailoring predictive maintenance to your unique needs. Reach out today, and together, let’s pave
the way for a more efficient, profitable and sustainable future.

# OEM Manufacturer in India for Mobile Accessories

##### Build your own branded earbuds, neckbands, chargers, and more — with complete OEM
##### customization, packaging, and low MOQ support.

At OEMitra, we specialize in delivering high-quality mobile accessories and electronics tailored to
your specifications. Our expertise ensures that you receive exceptional service and products that
enhance your brand’s presence. Partner with us for custom manufacturing solutions that meet your
unique business needs.

[ Request a Quote ][26]
[ Whatsapp ][27] [ Instagram ][28] [ Facebook-f ][29]

## Our OEM Solutions

*We specialize in custom manufacturing of mobile accessories for brands across India and globally.
Whether you’re launching a new product line or scaling up, OEMitra is your trusted OEM partner.*

### OEM Earbuds

**Modern, Compact & Wireless. Tailored for Your Brand.**
We manufacture high-quality TWS earbuds with Bluetooth 5.x, touch control, noise isolation, and
personalized branding options.

[ Learn More ][30]

### OEM Bluetooth Neckbands

**Flexible, Comfortable, and Built to Perform.**
From sports to daily wear models, we provide complete neckband OEM solutions with customization in
color, control modules, and battery specs.

[ Explore Now ][31]

### OEM Wired Earphones

**Reliable, Cost-Effective, and Built for Mass Appeal.**
Classic earphones with custom mic, driver, and wire options — optimized for volume production and
branding flexibility.

[ Get Started ][32]

### OEM Mobile Chargers

**Custom Fast Chargers Engineered for Global Safety Standards.**
Our OEM chargers comply with BIS and global norms, available in fast-charge, USB, and multi-port
configurations with brand-ready casing and packaging.

[ Discover More ][33]

### OEM Charging & Data Cables

**Durable. Branded. Fast.**
Customized mobile cables including USB-C, Micro USB, and Lightning. Fabric, PVC, or braided options
with fast charging and data sync features.

[ View Details ][34]

### OEM Smart Watches

**Smart. Stylish. Built for Modern Brands.**
Launch custom branded smart watches with modern display designs, fitness tracking features,
Bluetooth calling, health monitoring, and premium packaging solutions. We provide OEM smartwatch
solutions suitable for retail brands, online marketplaces, and promotional campaigns.

[ Explore Smartwatches ][35]

### OEM Power Banks

**Reliable Portable Power Solutions.**
Custom branded power banks with fast charging, multiple capacity options, Type-C support, and modern
retail-ready packaging. Suitable for corporate gifting, retail distribution, travel accessories, and
electronics brands.

## Trusted by Those Who Wear It

The RingConn Gen 2 represents this simplicity by blending sophisticated health monitoring with an
elegant design, focusing on the metrics that matter most.
[ [RinConn user information]][41]
When the dentist asked for the report of my husband's SpO2, which he forgot to bring, I showed him
the recorded monitoring in the RC2 app. The dentist was very impressed... and agreed that the oral
device was appropriate (to treat his sleep apnea).
[ [RinConn user information]Marni S.][42]
I had a pretty significant motorbike accident... The ring documented what was most likely a large
drop of blood pressure/shock and then the HR jump when the pain was starting to be realized by my
body... my ring is still showing my progress from that logged event. It’s really encouraging to see
my progress daily.
[ [RinConn user information]Rayn B.][43]

### The ViSi Mobile System is designed to monitor patients continuously in general care settings.

ViSi Mobile improves patient safety by utilizing *machine learning* from *[millions of hours][11] of
patient data* to recognize patient deterioration while minimizing alarm burden and maximizing
clinical workflow.

The ViSi Mobile System:[New Mannequin and stack]

 

 

 

**Elevating Patient Care with Real-Time, Continuous Monitoring**

In today’s fast-paced, often understaffed healthcare environments, critical changes in patient
vitals can be missed. Our advanced monitoring system provides continuous, cuff-less tracking of key
indicators—BP, SpO2, respiration, pulse, ECG, posture, and life-threatening arrhythmias—all streamed
in real time to the EMR. This proactive surveillance empowers healthcare teams to detect early signs
of sepsis and other critical events, enabling swift intervention. Seamlessly integrated into
hospital workflows, the system alerts staff when parameters are breached, improving patient outcomes
while saving time and resources.

[[Request A Demo]][12]

### Clinical Outcome Landscape

 

Vital sign collection has generally been ordered according to unit policy and not according to
patient need. Dangerous patient deterioration can occur in the interim between physical vital sign
spot checks.

2 [I2_Presentation_Diagnostics_Haraden.pdf][13]

3 Schein RM et al. Clinical antecedents to in-hospital cardiopulmonary arrest. Chest 1990;98:
1388-92.

[Maurice]

### The Benefits of ViSi Mobile Patient Monitoring System

Sotera's ViSi Mobile® Patient Monitoring System is a platform for comprehensive vital signs
monitoring that keeps clinicians connected to their patients, whether in bed, in transport or while
ambulating. Featuring comfortable body-worn sensors that allow for freedom of movement, the system
enables accurate, continuous monitoring of all core vital signs with beat-to-beat, noninvasive blood
pressure, as well as patient activity and posture. ViSi Mobile is a system designed to enhance
patient safety, allowing early detection of patient deterioration and connecting clinicians with
their patients anywhere, any time.

### The ViSi Mobile System is designed to monitor patients continuously in general care settings.

ViSi Mobile improves patient safety by utilizing *machine learning* from *[millions of hours][11] of
patient data* to recognize patient deterioration while minimizing alarm burden and maximizing
clinical workflow.

The ViSi Mobile System:[New Mannequin and stack]

 

 

 

**Elevating Patient Care with Real-Time, Continuous Monitoring**

In today’s fast-paced, often understaffed healthcare environments, critical changes in patient
vitals can be missed. Our advanced monitoring system provides continuous, cuff-less tracking of key
indicators—BP, SpO2, respiration, pulse, ECG, posture, and life-threatening arrhythmias—all streamed
in real time to the EMR. This proactive surveillance empowers healthcare teams to detect early signs
of sepsis and other critical events, enabling swift intervention. Seamlessly integrated into
hospital workflows, the system alerts staff when parameters are breached, improving patient outcomes
while saving time and resources.

Vital sign collection has generally been ordered according to unit policy and not according to
patient need. Dangerous patient deterioration can occur in the interim between physical vital sign
spot checks.

### The Benefits of ViSi Mobile Patient Monitoring System

Sotera's ViSi Mobile® Patient Monitoring System is a platform for comprehensive vital signs
monitoring that keeps clinicians connected to their patients, whether in bed, in transport or while
ambulating. Featuring comfortable body-worn sensors that allow for freedom of movement, the system
enables accurate, continuous monitoring of all core vital signs with beat-to-beat, noninvasive blood
pressure, as well as patient activity and posture. ViSi Mobile is a system designed to enhance
patient safety, allowing early detection of patient deterioration and connecting clinicians with
their patients anywhere, any time.

## Empowering Healthcare with Strategic Solutions

Access complete healthcare market research, with detailed analysis and insights to empower
businesses & make data-driven decisions.

Search

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

### Company Profiles

Detailed information of company and industry profiles, financial data, investment insights, business
periodicals, Mergers and Acquisitions along with the SWOT analysis.

### Segmental Analysis

# ERP knows the plan. Your shopfloor does something else

Workerbase connects your systems to your shopfloor operations, making sure what you plan on your ERP
and scheduled on your MES actually happens.

[Book a demo][3][Watch 2-minute demo][4]

Trusted by manufacturers running the most complex operations in the world

[Bosch]
[Siemens]
[thyssenkrupp]
[Porsche]
[GKN]
[Gazelle]
[Dantherm]

## Most plants fix problems in silos Workerbase bridges the gaps between them

One platform connecting every function on your shopfloor, so quality, maintenance, logistics, and
production move together, not in parallel. Explore each solution below.

ProductionMaintenanceQualityMaterial and LogisticsShopfloor

### Production

From the workstation to the line, every step is guided, every deviation caught and every stop
logged. Instructions enforced at the station: steps confirmed before the next opens, line stops
captured with reason and duration in real time, SAP updated automatically – no re-entry, no
end-of-shift catch-up.
* Digital work instructions & video SOPs
* Video-to-Checklist
* Paperless Batch / SAP
* OEE & Downtime Tracking

[Production team executing assembly operations on automotive line]
[Explore manual assembly][5][Explore machine operations][6]

## Here's why leading manufacturers use Workerbase

[Workerbase at the center connected to enterprise integrations including SAP, Siemens, Oracle,
Google Cloud, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Dynamics 365]

### Connect your systems

Plug in SAP, MES, SCADA, IoT sensors, or any data source via 100+ out-of-the-box integrations.
Workerbase turns that data into actionable tasks.

[Workflow builder with media input and mobile preview]

### Build your workflows

Your ops teams configure digital workflows, work instructions, and checklists in a no-code editor.
No IT project. No custom development. Live on one line in 2 weeks.

[Workerbase experience across tablet, phone, scanner, and smartwatch]

### Deploy to any device

Workers receive tasks and instructions on any device: tablet, smartphone, industrial smartwatch, or
kiosk. The right information, at the right station, in real time.

[Digital dashboard with issues, KPIs, and automated actions]

### Analyze and improve

Stronger analytics, faster value: real-time production and asset insight, gap detection, and the
KPIs that matter, from execution data your teams already create.

Workerbase AI agents

## Five AI agents to get started

Purpose-built AI that works inside your existing workflows – not bolted on as a separate tool. Each
agent solves one specific shopfloor problem. Live in days, not months.

### Troubleshooting agent

Operators get real-time, actionable resolution steps for alarms and disruptions – combining error
history and SOPs. No phone call. No manual.

### Data collector agent

Step-by-step guided data capture during events. Like an AI-driven, context-aware form. No blank
fields, no inconsistent formats.

### Incoming goods AI

Scan a delivery note. AI matches it to the ERP order, guides verification, posts the receipt
straight to the system. Dock to ERP in seconds.

### Find agent

Natural-language search across documents, checklists, videos and internal knowledge – answers in
seconds, directly at the station.

### Knowledge agent

Convert videos, audio or photos into structured digital work instructions. Knowledge captured simply
by recording. Publish the same day.

[Learn More][7]

## One platform, three ways it changes how the team works

### Shopfloor Operators

Real-time guidance at every station – the right instruction when it matters. Clear steps, confirmed
and done.

### Supervisors

Visibility across lines and shifts with less chasing. Escalations and reports largely handle
themselves so you focus on what matters.

### Operations Teams

Ship digitalization without IT overhead: configure workflows in hours and prove value before you
scale.

## What operations look like after closing the execution gap

Without Workerbase
With Workerbase

Finding information

Paper trails, multiple screens, calling the one person who knows.
Right information at the station. No searching, no waiting.

Training new staff

Weeks of shadowing. Knowledge locked in people's heads.
Guided from day one. Knowledge built into every workflow.

Shift handover

Manual and inconsistent. Things get lost at every handover.
Automatic, structured, complete. Nothing falls through.

Knowledge retention

Leaves with the worker when they go.
Embedded in the system. Available to everyone, always.

Creating workflows

Weeks of IT tickets and change requests.
Operations team configures and deploys. Hours, not months.

Reacting to problems

Supervisor scrambles. Manual workarounds. Same issue repeats next week.
Structured escalation from alarm to closure. Every step logged.

comprehensive, efficient, and affordable services universally accessible, ensuring that everyone can

Most repairs are completed within the same day, with more complex issues resolved within 48 hours,
ensuring minimal downtime for your devices.

We stand behind our work with a 6-month warranty on all repairs, covering both parts and labor for
your peace of mind.

gadgets. If you have a specific concern, please contact us to confirm we can meet your needs

Get custom alerts on your smartwatch when you receive a new notification on your smartphone, you'll
never miss any call or your friends' messages.

Add all your reminders to never miss an important event.

Use the music player buttons to run custom actions like change music track, start voice assistant,
run an Alexa routine, reply to a Whatsapp/Telegram message, …

Shenzhen COLMI Technology Co., Ltd , established in 2012, is a high-tech company focusing on the R&D
and manufacturing of smart wearable products. 
We have more than 50 COLMI brand agents in more than 20countries. We are also the OEM and ODM
partner of well-known smart wearable brands in several countries.

being as cost-effective as possible without sacrificing quality. That's why everything from our
design to manufacturing process is done with worker's care and attention to detail to ensure we
release only the most premium finished products on the market. We hope to use our more than ten
years of industry-leading experience to help you succeed in the smart wearable market.

[Open full usage guide][20]
My watch will not connect

Restart Bluetooth, keep the watch near the phone, remove stale pairings, then pair from inside Da
Fit. If your phone closes Da Fit in the background, follow the phone-system guide.

Notifications are not showing

Check notification permission, app-specific alert toggles, Do Not Disturb mode, and background
activity settings.

Sleep data is missing

Wear the device snugly while sleeping, sync data in time, and note that sleep is usually recorded
when sleep starts between 8 PM and 10 AM.

Weather is not displaying

Confirm the watch is connected, weather is enabled in Da Fit, location permission is allowed, and
weather data has synced from the phone.

# Smarter health worldwide.

The Global Digital Health Monitor is an interactive digital resource that tracks, monitors, and
evaluates the use of digital technology for health across countries.

[ Visit the MONITOR → ][18]
 
 
[
][19]


## About the Global Digital Health Monitor

The Global Digital Health Monitor (GDHM) is an interactive digital resource that helps countries to
prioritize and monitor their digital health interventions and enablers that uses the WHO/ITU eHealth
Strategy Toolkit as the underlying foundational framework. The tool consists of 23 indicators in the
areas of leadership & governance; strategy & investment; legislation, policy & compliance;
workforce; standards & interoperability; infrastructure; services & applications; and cross-cutting
issues like emerging technology and equity.

[evaluate.png]

**The aim of the global digital health monitor is to:**
* Monitor and improve quality of digital health at the country level
* Track progress towards comprehensive and integrated digital health systems 
* Identify areas of funding and technical assistance needs within and across countries  
* Encourage better alignment among policy makers, donors, and implementers in the digital health
  field in alignment with the Principles for Digital Development and Donor Alignment for Digital
  Health
* Highlight potential areas of risk for investment at the country level

In early 2016,[**health.enabled**][20] and the[ **Global Development Incubator (GDI)**][21]
partnered with[ **Dalberg’s Design Impact Group (DIG)**][22],[ **ThoughtWorks**][23], and
representatives from 20+ countries and 50+ international agencies and organizations to design the
**Global Digital Health Index (GDHI)**.

In 2022, the GDHI underwent a year-long review and redesign process to align the indicators with the
World Health Organization (WHO) Global Digital Health Strategy as a complement to the WHO Digital
Health Atlas and include a greater focus on AI, equity, gender, and Universal Health Coverage.

In 2023, the name was changed to the **Global Digital Health Monitor (GDHM)** to articulate the
platform’s value in monitoring digital health progress at the country, regional, and global levels.
The updated GDHM includes year on year performance monitoring country visualizations, regional
visualizations, and country to country comparisons.

The GDHM is now officially recognized as the monitoring platform for digital health ecosystems in
WHO Member States, serving as a critical tool for standardizing, tracking, and advancing digital
health progress globally.

**Learn more **[**here**][24]** (**[**French version**][25]**).**


## Team

The GDHM is co-facilitated by [**health.enabled**][26], a digital health nonprofit, and the
[**Global Development Incubator (GDI)**][27]**,** an organization that builds social impact startups
and partnerships. [**ThoughtWorks**][28] is the technology partner and [**Dalberg Design**][29] is
the design partner.

[
][30]
 
 


## Technical Committee

The GDHM Technical Committee includes a broad range of government, private sector, academic, NGO,
and other top institutions and individuals in digital health:

* Joseline Carias, **RECAINSA **

* Tim Wood, **Gates Foundation**


## Partners

In addition to our team and funders, GDHM is pleased to count several global organizations as
partners, including the [Asian Development Bank][31], [Asia eHealth Information Network][32],
[Commonwealth Medical Organization][33], [EMPHNET][34], [International Development Research

# Training that delivers results.

Download App

Integration with smart watches
Sync your app with your smartwatch to receive real-time workout data and monitor your progress right
on your wrist.
Quick access to all functions
All the necessary tools for your workouts are in one place. A training plan, progress tracking, or
AI tips are available in two clicks.
Workouts with a locked screen
Do not be distracted by unlocking your device during your workout. You can monitor the process even
with the screen locked, which makes using the app convenient and safe.
Intuitive interface
The application is designed so that every user, regardless of the level of technical training, can
easily understand and get started. Just install and follow the instructions.
about us

## We understand that every step towards health and fitness should be simple and inspiring. That's
## why we created Gloox, a mobile fitness app where your comfort and freedom come first.

Fitness has become easier
Our app supports smartwatch operation to make your workouts even more effective.
Now you can monitor your progress at any time.
Access to ready-made training plans
If you don't want to waste time developing your programs, choose from a variety of ready-made
training plans created by professional trainers.
Individual approach to training
Change your training plans at any time. Your goals, schedule, and training level may change, and our
service allows you to adjust your program without unnecessary difficulties.
Your workouts — your way
Build your own programs or choose from ready-made plans.
Ai nutritionist
- Personal recommendations: Takes into account goals, preferences and allergies.
- Diet Tracking: Daily nutrition correction tips.
Ai coach
- Personalized plans: Takes into account the level, goals and preferences.
- Progress analysis: Tracking and recommendations for improvement.
Ai doctor
- Analysis and recommendations: Improves well-being in real time.
- Prevention and diagnosis: Indicates risks and suggests measures in advance.
Ai assistant
- Organization of the day:
Helps you plan your workouts, work, and vacations effectively.
- Reminders:
Notifies you about workouts, meals, and medical checkups.
Your coach, always with you
Get smart guidance and personalised plans from your AI coach.
Increased power and speed
Alternating between exercise and rest contributes to the development of strength and speed.
Improvement of the cardiovascular system
Interval training stimulates the heart and increases lung capacity.
Increased metabolism
An increased metabolic rate after exercise helps burn calories even at rest.
Effective calorie burning
Intense exercise allows you to achieve a calorie deficit faster, contributing to weight loss.
Boost your endurance
Interval training designed for maximum effectiveness.
Increasing the effectiveness of training
The analysis of daily results allows you to optimize workouts and increase their effect.
Visualizing progress
Graphs and infographics make it easy to assess changes in results and achievements.
More precise planning
Users can adjust their fitness goals and plans based on detailed data from previous sessions.
Motivation
Visual representation of data serves as a motivator and allows users to see real improvements.
Track your progress day by day
Detailed daily reports help you see your growth, step by step.
This is a section with frequently asked questions and answers. Popular user questions are collected
here so that you can easily understand all the nuances of usage.
FAQ
What workouts are available in the app?
The app offers workouts for various fitness levels: cardio, strength training, yoga, stretching, and
much more.
Is it necessary to purchase a paid subscription?
Basic features are free. A subscription is required for access to advanced workouts and personalized
programs.
Can I track my results?
Yes, the app automatically tracks your progress, the number of workouts completed, calories burned,
and achievements.
Does the app support creating a personalized plan?
Yes, the app creates a personalized workout plan based on your goals and parameters.
What devices are supported?
The app is available for iOS and Android smartphones. Some features can connect to fitness bands and
smartwatches.
Can workouts be done offline without internet access?
Yes, many workouts and plans can be downloaded in advance and used without an internet connection.
Your progress will sync when the internet is available again.

* What is Google Health and how does it work?
  Google Health is a health and wellness service that tracks your fitness, sleep and health data
  through wearables like Fitbit, Pixel Watch and other devices. It includes a digital health coach
  built with Gemini that works as your AI coach, using your metrics to adapt workout plans, optimise
  your sleep schedule and answer health and wellness questions specific to you. Developed with
  health experts, your coach gets smarter as it learns your patterns, helping you make progress that
  actually sticks.^{1, 2}
* What can you do with Google Health?
  The Google Health app brings together your fitness, sleep, and health data from wearables and apps
  to give you a holistic view of your health and wellness in one place. With a Premium membership,
  you get an AI coach built with Gemini that gives you workout plans that adjust based on how
  recovered you are, helps you find out how much sleep your body needs, and answers questions about
  nutrition or what your metrics mean.^{1, 2}
* Is Google Health free of charge?
  Yes, Google Health can be downloaded and used free of charge. You can track your metrics at no
  cost. There's also a Premium membership available that unlocks proactive coaching and
  personalisation across fitness, sleep and health.¹
* Can Google Health connect with other health apps and devices?
  Yes. Google Health connects with a wide range of wearables, apps and devices for activity and
  wellness tracking. It works with Fitbit, Pixel Watch and other compatible trackers, syncing data
  from fitness apps, smart scales, glucose monitors and more.
* Can Google Health help track your period?
  Yes. Google Health tracks your menstrual cycle, including predicted periods, fertile windows and
  symptoms like mood, flow and energy. Your data builds over time, giving you a clearer picture of
  your cycle and how it connects to your sleep, fitness and daily routines. You can also ask Google
  Health Coach questions about your cycle health at any time and get answers based on your personal
  data.^{1,3}

* Il nostro team verifica e aggiorna manualmente i prezzi di ogni operatore ogni settimana. Nessun
  dato obsoleto così che ogni utente possa identificare le migliori offerte del momento.
* Oltre al comparatore, offriamo strumenti gratuiti: speedtest, mappe di copertura e l'analisi della
  tua fattura attuale (Offer-check) che permettono di trovare veramente il migliore abbonamento per
  ogni casistica.

  determinati operatori. I risultati sono ordinati per prezzo, non per accordi commerciali.

  dato obsoleto così che ogni utente possa identificare le migliori offerte del momento.

  tua fattura attuale (Offer-check) che permettono di trovare veramente il migliore abbonamento per
  ogni casistica.

# What’s There In The Solution

## Connected Devices
* Access to bluetooth connected Glucometer, Blood pressure monitor, Weighing scale, Fetal heart
  monitor & Hemoglobinometer.
* Track real time vitals, watch trends and download reports.

## Support at your finger tips
* One-on-one expert support through our partner care providers (Doctors, Nurses and Health Coaches).
* Timely technical support for devices and emergencies.

## Nudges and Alerts
* Evidence based nudges to help patients stay on track.
* Personalized engagement programs for improving patient compliance.

# How remote monitoring works*

## Care provider recommends
* Doctors prescribe the package and enroll the patient.

## Registration
* Patients enter their details and register themselves on the platform. After which the care
  management team designs a plan personalized for them.

## Patient Onboarding
* The care management team will send a device kit to the patient and onboard the patient on our
  platform.

## Journey Begins
* The patient downloads the app and starts monitoring to begin their journey towards a healthier
  life!

*For our one-to-many model please check the [population health][27] page

# Testimonials
* Medtel provides the most comprehensive solutions for tele-medicine. With its multi-platform access
  and IoT devices for effective diagnosis, we are convinced that Medtel is the right partner to
  ensure effective and reliable solutions for our clients.
  
  Swagat R Pyakurel
  
  Co Founder, E-Swasthya
* Seamless and Smart Remote Monitoring. Patients are now engaged efficiently. The usage generates
  data which allows more interventions. The solution is comprehensive. Most hospitals will adapt to
  this sooner or later.
  
  Apex Group of Hospitals
  
  Deputy General Manager – Marketing
* Datweal Connected Health Station is a good tech addition to Fortis Hospital, Bannerghata Road,
  Bangalore. It is a user-friendly self operating kiosk which assesses the body composition and
  health risk of the users and at the same time the backend lead tracking mechanism is very
  comprehensive. It enables fortis team to know about abnormalities of the users and facilitates
  them to take health consultations from appropriate doctors and take preventive measures.
  
  Mr Rajeev Das
  
  Marketing Head, Fortis Healthcare

## Our OEM Solutions

*We specialize in custom manufacturing of mobile accessories for brands across India and globally.
Whether you’re launching a new product line or scaling up, OEMitra is your trusted OEM partner.*

### OEM Earbuds

**Modern, Compact & Wireless. Tailored for Your Brand.**

personalized branding options.

### The ViSi Mobile System is designed to monitor patients continuously in general care settings.

ViSi Mobile improves patient safety by utilizing *machine learning* from *[millions of hours][11] of
patient data* to recognize patient deterioration while minimizing alarm burden and maximizing
clinical workflow.

The ViSi Mobile System:[New Mannequin and stack]

 

 

 

**Elevating Patient Care with Real-Time, Continuous Monitoring**

In today’s fast-paced, often understaffed healthcare environments, critical changes in patient
vitals can be missed. Our advanced monitoring system provides continuous, cuff-less tracking of key
indicators—BP, SpO2, respiration, pulse, ECG, posture, and life-threatening arrhythmias—all streamed
in real time to the EMR. This proactive surveillance empowers healthcare teams to detect early signs
of sepsis and other critical events, enabling swift intervention. Seamlessly integrated into
hospital workflows, the system alerts staff when parameters are breached, improving patient outcomes
while saving time and resources.

[[Request A Demo]][12]

### Clinical Outcome Landscape

 

Vital sign collection has generally been ordered according to unit policy and not according to
patient need. Dangerous patient deterioration can occur in the interim between physical vital sign
spot checks.

### The Benefits of ViSi Mobile Patient Monitoring System

Sotera's ViSi Mobile® Patient Monitoring System is a platform for comprehensive vital signs
monitoring that keeps clinicians connected to their patients, whether in bed, in transport or while
ambulating. Featuring comfortable body-worn sensors that allow for freedom of movement, the system
enables accurate, continuous monitoring of all core vital signs with beat-to-beat, noninvasive blood
pressure, as well as patient activity and posture. ViSi Mobile is a system designed to enhance
patient safety, allowing early detection of patient deterioration and connecting clinicians with
their patients anywhere, any time.

### The ViSi Mobile System is designed to monitor patients continuously in general care settings.

ViSi Mobile improves patient safety by utilizing *machine learning* from *[millions of hours][11] of
patient data* to recognize patient deterioration while minimizing alarm burden and maximizing
clinical workflow.

The ViSi Mobile System:[New Mannequin and stack]

 

 

 

**Elevating Patient Care with Real-Time, Continuous Monitoring**

In today’s fast-paced, often understaffed healthcare environments, critical changes in patient
vitals can be missed. Our advanced monitoring system provides continuous, cuff-less tracking of key
indicators—BP, SpO2, respiration, pulse, ECG, posture, and life-threatening arrhythmias—all streamed
in real time to the EMR. This proactive surveillance empowers healthcare teams to detect early signs
of sepsis and other critical events, enabling swift intervention. Seamlessly integrated into
hospital workflows, the system alerts staff when parameters are breached, improving patient outcomes
while saving time and resources.

[[Request A Demo]][12]

### Clinical Outcome Landscape

 

Vital sign collection has generally been ordered according to unit policy and not according to
patient need. Dangerous patient deterioration can occur in the interim between physical vital sign
spot checks.

[Maurice]

### The Benefits of ViSi Mobile Patient Monitoring System

Sotera's ViSi Mobile® Patient Monitoring System is a platform for comprehensive vital signs
monitoring that keeps clinicians connected to their patients, whether in bed, in transport or while
ambulating. Featuring comfortable body-worn sensors that allow for freedom of movement, the system
enables accurate, continuous monitoring of all core vital signs with beat-to-beat, noninvasive blood
pressure, as well as patient activity and posture. ViSi Mobile is a system designed to enhance
patient safety, allowing early detection of patient deterioration and connecting clinicians with
their patients anywhere, any time.

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

### Company Profiles

Detailed information of company and industry profiles, financial data, investment insights, business
periodicals, Mergers and Acquisitions along with the SWOT analysis.

### Segmental Analysis

Complete analysis of all the segments covered in the report, with their market dynamics to get an
overall understanding of the current market scenario.

### Market Share Analysis (MSA)

Evaluating competitive marketing effectiveness through Market Share Analysis (MSA) to gain a
complete sense of specific market that will impact your revenue.

# ERP knows the plan. Your shopfloor does something else

Workerbase connects your systems to your shopfloor operations, making sure what you plan on your ERP
and scheduled on your MES actually happens.

[Book a demo][3][Watch 2-minute demo][4]

Trusted by manufacturers running the most complex operations in the world

[Bosch]
[Siemens]
[thyssenkrupp]
[Porsche]
[GKN]
[Gazelle]
[Dantherm]

## Most plants fix problems in silos Workerbase bridges the gaps between them

One platform connecting every function on your shopfloor, so quality, maintenance, logistics, and
production move together, not in parallel. Explore each solution below.

ProductionMaintenanceQualityMaterial and LogisticsShopfloor

### Production

From the workstation to the line, every step is guided, every deviation caught and every stop
logged. Instructions enforced at the station: steps confirmed before the next opens, line stops
captured with reason and duration in real time, SAP updated automatically – no re-entry, no
end-of-shift catch-up.
* Digital work instructions & video SOPs
* Video-to-Checklist
* Paperless Batch / SAP
* OEE & Downtime Tracking

[Production team executing assembly operations on automotive line]
[Explore manual assembly][5][Explore machine operations][6]

## Here's why leading manufacturers use Workerbase

[Workerbase at the center connected to enterprise integrations including SAP, Siemens, Oracle,
Google Cloud, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Dynamics 365]

### Connect your systems

Plug in SAP, MES, SCADA, IoT sensors, or any data source via 100+ out-of-the-box integrations.
Workerbase turns that data into actionable tasks.

[Workflow builder with media input and mobile preview]

### Build your workflows

Your ops teams configure digital workflows, work instructions, and checklists in a no-code editor.
No IT project. No custom development. Live on one line in 2 weeks.

[Workerbase experience across tablet, phone, scanner, and smartwatch]

### Deploy to any device

Workers receive tasks and instructions on any device: tablet, smartphone, industrial smartwatch, or
kiosk. The right information, at the right station, in real time.

[Digital dashboard with issues, KPIs, and automated actions]

### Analyze and improve

Stronger analytics, faster value: real-time production and asset insight, gap detection, and the
KPIs that matter, from execution data your teams already create.

Workerbase AI agents

## Five AI agents to get started

Purpose-built AI that works inside your existing workflows – not bolted on as a separate tool. Each
agent solves one specific shopfloor problem. Live in days, not months.

### Troubleshooting agent

Operators get real-time, actionable resolution steps for alarms and disruptions – combining error
history and SOPs. No phone call. No manual.

### Data collector agent

Step-by-step guided data capture during events. Like an AI-driven, context-aware form. No blank
fields, no inconsistent formats.

### Incoming goods AI

Scan a delivery note. AI matches it to the ERP order, guides verification, posts the receipt
straight to the system. Dock to ERP in seconds.

### Find agent

Natural-language search across documents, checklists, videos and internal knowledge – answers in
seconds, directly at the station.

### Knowledge agent

Convert videos, audio or photos into structured digital work instructions. Knowledge captured simply
by recording. Publish the same day.

[Learn More][7]

## One platform, three ways it changes how the team works

### Shopfloor Operators

Real-time guidance at every station – the right instruction when it matters. Clear steps, confirmed
and done.

### Supervisors

Visibility across lines and shifts with less chasing. Escalations and reports largely handle
themselves so you focus on what matters.

### Operations Teams

Ship digitalization without IT overhead: configure workflows in hours and prove value before you
scale.

## What operations look like after closing the execution gap

Without Workerbase
With Workerbase

Finding information

Paper trails, multiple screens, calling the one person who knows.
Right information at the station. No searching, no waiting.

Training new staff

Weeks of shadowing. Knowledge locked in people's heads.
Guided from day one. Knowledge built into every workflow.

Shift handover

Manual and inconsistent. Things get lost at every handover.
Automatic, structured, complete. Nothing falls through.

Knowledge retention

Leaves with the worker when they go.
Embedded in the system. Available to everyone, always.

Creating workflows

Weeks of IT tickets and change requests.
Operations team configures and deploys. Hours, not months.

Reacting to problems

Supervisor scrambles. Manual workarounds. Same issue repeats next week.
Structured escalation from alarm to closure. Every step logged.

# Fast and reliable gadget repair services

Welcome to Mobile Tech, where we bring your beloved gadgets back to life with speed and reliability.
Specializing in smartphones, tablets, and more, our team provides comprehensive repair solutions to
ensure your devices are always in peak condition.

[ Get Started ][50]
[ Contact Us ][51]


### Our goal:

"We will fix it, till we make it"

###### about our culture

## Meet Mobile Tech: Your Trusted Repair Partner

At Mobile Tech, we’re dedicated to top-notch gadget repairs. Our skilled technicians work fast,
deliver reliable service, and keep prices affordable. We make sure every repair meets high quality
standards and leaves customers satisfied.

###### our vision & mission

## Shaping the Future of Gadget Care

Our vision at Mobile Tech is to revolutionize the gadget repair industry by making our
comprehensive, efficient, and affordable services universally accessible, ensuring that everyone can
benefit from technology care without hassle. We are on a mission to deliver fast, reliable repairs
across a broad spectrum of electronic devices, emphasizing customer satisfaction and quality to keep
you connected to what matters most.

How long will my repair take?

Most repairs are completed within the same day, with more complex issues resolved within 48 hours,
ensuring minimal downtime for your devices.

What kind of warranty do you offer on repairs?

We stand behind our work with a 6-month warranty on all repairs, covering both parts and labor for
your peace of mind.

Can you repair any brand of gadget?

Our team is skilled in a wide range of brands and models, offering reliable repairs for most major
gadgets. If you have a specific concern, please contact us to confirm we can meet your needs

OEM/ODM services for **sports/pocket cameras and smartwatches**. We are committed to delivering
innovative imaging devices and wearables that help you capture life’s moments, enhance fitness
routines, and enrich daily life.
 
As a leading manufacturer in China, we offer end-to-end solutions for both product lines: for
cameras, we cover gimbal system design, 2K/4K image tuning, noise reduction audio processing, WiFi
connectivity, and mobile app integration; for smartwatches, we provide full support from ID & MD
design to firmware development and UI customization. All services are backed by our 30-member strong
R&D team.
 
Join us at Weiwo as we embark on a journey towards a smarter and more connected world, one camera
and one smartwatch at a time.
